subject: health
concept: Applying balanced eating, hydration, varied activity types, energy, and enjoyment to a full healthy-week plan, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple weekly plan including balanced meals, water, and a mix of activity types
exercise.abstract: Student explains why their plan reflects a healthy, enjoyable balance

assessment.mastery_threshold: plan includes balanced food variety and at least two different types of physical activity
misconception_flags: plan is overly restrictive or excludes entire food groups or activity types

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
